name: Bandit Quests
source:
The story is about a not so great hero being caught by bandit girls and forced into servitude in their hideout. As the days are passing by, the protagonist slowly starts to have feelings for his captors...

Note: The graphics of the visual novel are all screencaps from a heavily modded version of The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion.
translation:
故事讲述了一位不那么伟大的英雄被强盗女孩抓住并被迫在她们的藏身处当奴隶的故事。随着日子一天天过去，主角慢慢对绑架他的人产生了感情……

注：视觉小说的图形全部来自《上古卷轴IV：湮没》的经过大量修改的版本的屏幕截图。
